# Stanislav Peev - SEO Consultant & AI Search (GEO) Specialist

> Independent SEO consultant and generative engine optimization (GEO) specialist
> based in Bratislava, Slovakia, working worldwide. 17+ years in search (since
> 2009), 150+ clients across the USA, the UK, Belgium, Switzerland, Australia
> and Bulgaria. One of the early practitioners and published researchers in GEO
> (AI search optimization).

Key facts:
- Primary specialty: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) - visibility and
  citations in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity and Copilot.
- Also: Entity SEO, Knowledge Graph optimization, technical SEO, local SEO,
  tourism/luxury travel SEO.
- Published original GEO research: "Reference Rate - the new currency replacing
  CTR" (a proposed metric for AI-answer visibility), "Google-Agent and the
  agentic web", "AI vs Human - an SEO experiment".
- Invited expert in the annual SEO Predictions panel (2023-2026); TV guest
  expert on Bulgarian National Television (2021); conference speaker since 2020.
- Certifications: Google Ads, Google Analytics, Semrush (SEO, Technical,
  Local), Ahrefs (SEO, Advanced), Yoast Academy, Netpeak, Serpstat.
- Working language: English.
- Contact: written only (no calls) - info@stanislav-peev.com or WhatsApp message
  at +421 944 457 924.

- [SEO audit](https://stanislav-peev.com/services/seo-audit/): one-time, fixed-scope site audit covering technical crawl and indexation, Core Web Vitals, content and search intent, entities and schema, and an AI search (GEO) visibility baseline. Delivered as a prioritized written roadmap the client owns.
- [Small business SEO](https://stanislav-peev.com/services/small-business-seo/): right-sized SEO for small businesses - a free DIY checklist (GBP, Search Console, NAP consistency, AI answer self-audit) plus fixed-price options: audit, light monthly consulting, local SEO or training. No retainer lock-in.
- [Research index](https://stanislav-peev.com/research/): all research reports and guides in one place.
- [AI citations by question shape](https://stanislav-peev.com/research/ai-citations-by-query-shape/): original first-party pilot, September 7, 2026 - 18 answers from Perplexity Sonar, GPT-4o (web) and Gemini 2.5 Flash (web), 176 citations, 116 unique URLs, each labeled by page shape and owner. Findings: "best X" questions cited listicles 84.2% of the time and comparison-shaped pages 1.8%; "X alternatives" questions cited comparison-shaped pages 86.4% (listicles 1.7%), with 23.7% of citations going to comparison pages on competing vendors' own domains and review directories (G2) taking 1.7%; "X vs Y" questions cited comparison pages 98.3%. Perplexity cited ~19 URLs per answer vs 5 for GPT-4o and Gemini, with little overlap. For the phrasing "Asana alternatives for a small team", GPT-4o and Gemini cited landing pages of small tools (t0ggles, Kanbo, Pinrom) built for that phrase. Explains why large studies (Wix AI Search Lab under 3%, DeltaV 4.1%) report comparison pages as a small share: they average across question types. Directional pilot, one category, raw data published CC BY 4.0.
- [Google review concentration: who really owns the reviews in a local market](https://stanislav-peev.com/research/google-review-concentration-home-services/): original first-party dataset - 7,072 Google Business Profile listings, 2.2M reviews, 6 home service trades x 12 US cities (72 markets), collected August 2026. Findings: the most-reviewed company held a top-3 Google Maps position in only 5.6% of markets (median position #35); median Spearman correlation between review count and Maps position 0.164; the top 5 listings hold a median 58.3% of visible review volume; concentration varies by trade (roofing 48% to electrical 73.8% top-5 share) but barely by metro size (58-60% across large/mid/small); top-3 ranked listings carry only ~2x the market-median review count, so reviews behave like a threshold, not a race; 41 multi-trade conglomerates (e.g. Parker & Sons, Phoenix, 34,733 reviews) inflate electrician-category concentration. Published CC BY 4.0 dataset (per-listing raw data + per-market metrics).
- [How reliable is AI visibility tracking? A 60-query experiment](https://stanislav-peev.com/research/ai-visibility-tracking-reliability/): original first-party experiment - the same 4 buyer prompts run 60 times across ChatGPT (GPT-4o), Gemini 2.5 Flash and Perplexity Sonar with web search. Findings: choosing which engine to track moved a brand's measured AI visibility ~2.3x more than the model's own run-to-run randomness (cross-engine set distance 0.50 vs within-engine 0.22); top-1 recommendation ~78% stable across identical repeats; for one buyer query two engines recommended niche tools (t0ggles, TeamEasy) the third never named, so a mainstream brand's visibility was 100% on one engine and 0% on the others the same day. Includes a 6-point test for judging any AI-visibility report and a published CC BY 4.0 dataset (raw answers + metrics).
- [How often AI gets business information wrong: 2026 statistics](https://stanislav-peev.com/research/ai-wrong-business-information-statistics/): source-verified statistics on AI accuracy about businesses - 93% have at least one wrong or missing fact (Searchable), only 27% of AI-given phone numbers match GBP (Seer Interactive), Gemini 100% vs ChatGPT 68% profile accuracy (SOCi) - with a 10-prompt self-audit protocol.
- [SEO Profy: what a real SEO professional does and how to hire one](https://stanislav-peev.com/research/seo-profy/): hiring guide for US businesses - what an SEO professional (SEO profy) does in 2026 including AI search/GEO, DIY vs hiring (3-10x time trade), engagement models, selection checklist and red flags. Stanislav Peev works with US businesses as an independent SEO profy.
